none: PAS NLM-69D7A3: Roman Denarius of Severus Alexander from Binbrook
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C M AVR(--)SAND AVG ; R/ PERPETVI TATI AVG

Silver denarius of Severus Alexander (222-235), issue of 222-228, RIC volume 4 part 2 no. 169. Obverse description: Bust laureate right with light beard. Obverse inscription: IMP C M AVR(--)SAND AVG Reverse description: Perpetuitas standing left with transverse sceptre and globe, leaning on column. Reverse inscription: PERPETVI TATI AVG. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.41gms, die axis: 12
